## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits format (`type(scope): description`)
- [ ] Branch name follows the naming convention (`type/short-description`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (skip for `chore`/`ci`/`docs`)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` values committed
- [ ] OpenAPI spec regenerated if backend routes changed (`cd app && npm run generate-spec`)
- [ ] Breaking changes documented in the PR body and marked `BREAKING CHANGE:` in the commit footer
